profile.headline: Firmware Engineer at Amphenol Network Solutions

positions.title: Sr. Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and Lead development using C++ in embedded Linux and Android for new feature to allow existing VoIP desktop and conference table phones to be compliant with Alyssa's Law. This new feature will unlock the 1M+ device education market for HP sales and for partner and Telecom provider sales markets. Additionally reviewed and recommended integration with Singlewire.com Informacast product to compliment Alyssa's Law features.

Implemented FIPS compliant runtime environment for embedded Linux VoIP phones. Using OpenSSL, modified boot sequence to install and validate FIPS providers and make FIPS mode the default runtime configuration.

Designed and developed internal API communications for Poly Studio Room Solutions for Microsoft Teams. Development was done in Kotlin for the communication between the HP Mini PC and the Android based table top kiosk devices. API handled all communication between PC and device including firmware upgrade and downgrade functionality.

Presented demo of using AI to instrument legacy code with trace macros in C++ and then using the resulting trace logs, again via AI to generate sequence diagrams to get a better understanding of system component interaction.

positions.title: Sr. Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Mentored an offshore team in migrating Outlook integration for VoIP Call Server/Router product.

Mentored team of contractors taking over maintenance of VoIP Server product.

Maintained and enhanced H.323/SIP call handling, REST APIs, and call-detail-record publishing in 
 VoIP Call server/router.

positions.title: Sr. Staff Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Developed Rest API functionality to expose all core functionality to external client systems. API were defined using WADL. 

Extended and maintained VoIP network edge device for use with VoIP call server/router to allow external devices to participate in video and audio conferencing. Tightly integrated TURN server to provide media path for traversing firewalls.

Lead team to develop API for call detail record publication for port of VoIP call server/router from JBoss to   Glassfish. Received award for delivering solid solution before delivery date.

Designed and developed high availability monitoring system for cluster based deployments of VoIP Call server/router based on Corosync, Pacemaker and embedded Lua.

Designed and developed H.323 fire walling system for preventing DDOS attacks from improperly configured, faulty firmware, and compromised endpoints.

Worked customer escalations, fixing defects and providing RCA to support staff.
Extended and maintained VoIP Call server/router.

positions.title: VP Technology & Operations
positions.description:
Managed development teams in Denver, Co, and Montpellier France.

Managed day to day operations in data centers in Aurora Co, and Montpellier France.

Responsible for server deployment, firewalls, routing, and troubleshooting.

Designed, developed, and integrated conferencing system into Adobe Connect Servers.

Designed and lead team to develop customer facing web based audio conferencing management interface for conference hosts.

Designed and developed Web based content management sharing system for use
with audio conferencing system.

Designed and developed VoIP audio conferencing platform. This was the primary
revenue source for the business. System was written in Java and used Vail Systems soft Media Servers running on Solaris.  Core conferencing application was designed as a servlet container to take advantage of the Vail Soft Media Servers outbound HTTP API.  Developed event and data transport system to replace slow Message Queue based platform the project initially started with.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and implemented SIP VoIP server in C++ to allow use of Convedia media servers to replace existing Dialogic based conferencing system. Developed API to new SIP server that matched the existing Dialogic API so that the new system was a drop in replacement for the rest of the conferencing platform.

Mentored developers in Java application and applet development.

Maintained and extended Delphi VoIP conference host management software.

positions.title: Sr. Softeare Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on IDE and SCSI Hard Disk BIOS  installation software. 

Worked on Delphi based PC system imaging software. Product allowed Administrators to rapidly deploy many PC systems simultaneously via multicast HDD imaging. 

Lead team and developed ATA-4 Host protected area tools to image hard drives for manufactures and end users. 

After office closed down, continued on as contractor to complete the ATA-4  HPA tools, which were bundled in millions of IBM PCs and Laptops as their Rapid Recovery Product.
